visits.title: Visits
visits.description: Open a visit with the patient, examination type, fee, and date. Examination details are recorded later.
visits.openVisitDescription: Search by name or phone, or add a new patient. Then set the examination type, fee, and date.
visits.searchPatientPlaceholder: Search patients by name or phone
visits.startDescription: Record vitals, clinical notes, prescription, and lab orders. Saving marks this examination as done.
visits.formDescription: Patient, examination type, and date are required.
visits.printEmpty: Nothing to print for this visit.
visits.visitHeldNotice: This visit is on hold because the patient was not here for their turn. Return them to the queue when they arrive.
visits.holdDescription: Hold the visit for “{{name}}”? Use this when the patient is not here for their turn. You can return them to the queue later.
visits.reenqueueDescription: Return “{{name}}” to the queue three visits after the current turn? If fewer visits remain, they go last.
visits.reenqueueFailed: Unable to return the visit to the queue.
visits.doctorDashboardDescription: Start the day to open the first examination. All visits are listed; choose a date to filter by day.
visits.examinationPendingNotice: Examination details have not been recorded yet.
visits.cancelDescription: Cancel the visit for “{{name}}”? Only visits that have not been started can be canceled.
visits.invalidAmount: Enter a fee of zero or more.
visits.invalidVitals: Check the vitals. Empty is allowed; filled values must be in range.
visits.invalidBloodPressure: Enter both systolic and diastolic blood pressure, or leave both blank.
visits.deleteDescription: Delete the visit for “{{name}}”? This cannot be undone.
